name: finometr
description: Ask ChatGPT about your Finometr cash flow (balances, transactions, the forecast, budgets, projects and a daily brief) and let it keep your books with you: accounts, transactions, statements, recurring payments, categories, projects and hours.

interface.longDescription: Finometr shows the cash flow of your business units from your bank accounts and manual accounts. Ask for a daily brief, balances, transactions, planned payments, the cash-flow forecast with the day your cash goes below its threshold, spending against the month's budget, how planned payments compare with what really happened, and each project's money and hours against plan. Finometr can also add manual accounts, transactions and planned or recurring payments, import a bank statement you share, set categories, notes and projects on transactions, create custom categories inside the standard ones on Pro and higher, log hours, set a month's target, change notification settings, manage the roles of people in your units and send the Finometr team a financing request you filled in together. It never moves money and never removes or edits bank transactions, only their category and note. Removing is soft: transactions and accounts you added by hand, projects, recurring payments, time entries and shared copies can be restored. Bank connections and invitations are made in the Finometr app.
defaultPrompt: Give me my Finometr daily brief.
When does my cash go below its threshold in the next three months?
How is this month's spending against my budget?

positive.description: Daily brief across the user's units
positive.prompt: Give me my Finometr daily brief.
positive.expected_behavior: Names the connected account, then gives balances for Personal and Northwind Studio, recent large transactions and the payments due this week, from the demo data.

positive.prompt: What payments are planned for Northwind Studio in the next two weeks?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Invoice 1044 Blue Harbor Ltd (+3,900 EUR), Office rent Kanalweg 3 (-1,450 EUR) and VAT prepayment (-2,600 EUR) with their dates.

positive.prompt: Will Northwind Studio's cash go below its threshold in the next three months?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers from the forecast whether and when the unit's balance goes below its cash-gap threshold, and gives the lowest balance it reaches.

positive.prompt: How much did Northwind Studio pay contractors and for software last month?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Contractor fee M. Weber (-2,100 EUR) and Design software subscription (-59 EUR) in last month's transactions and adds them up.

positive.description: Add a planned payment after confirmation
positive.prompt: Plan a payment of 250 EUR called "Printer service" on the Studio current account for next Friday.
positive.expected_behavior: States what it will add and where, then adds a planned payment of -250 EUR named Printer service on the Studio current account for that date and confirms it.

positive.description: Remove a manual transaction after confirmation, and restore it
positive.prompt: Delete the "Bank fees" transaction, then bring it back.
positive.expected_behavior: Names the row (Bank fees, -18.50 EUR) and the connected account, removes it after the user's yes, then restores it and confirms it is back.

positive.description: Create a project and log hours on it after confirmation
positive.prompt: Create a project "Website for Blue Harbor" in Northwind Studio with 40 planned hours, then log 3 hours on it for today.
positive.expected_behavior: Names the connected account, says what it will create, then creates the project in Northwind Studio and logs 3 hours on it for today, and confirms both.

positive.description: Start a recurring payment after confirmation
positive.prompt: Make the Northwind Studio office rent a monthly recurring payment of 1,450 EUR on the Studio current account, from the 4th of next month.
positive.expected_behavior: States the payment it will start (-1,450 EUR monthly on the Studio current account from the 4th of next month), starts it after the user's yes and says the next dates it planned.

positive.prompt: How do the planned payments on the Studio current account compare with what really happened?
positive.expected_behavior: Says which planned payments of the Studio current account are matched, still waiting or overdue, with their amounts, from the demo data.

positive.prompt: What is my cash-gap threshold, and how does Finometr notify me?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the cash-gap threshold and horizon and the notification channels per category, without changing anything.

negative.description: Moving money is not supported: Finometr has no payment tool
negative.prompt: Transfer 500 EUR from the Studio current account to M. Weber.

negative.description: Bank credentials are never taken in the chat; banks are connected in the Finometr app
negative.prompt: Connect my bank account, my login is demo and password is 1234.

negative.description: Invitations are sent in the Finometr app, not from the chat
negative.prompt: Invite anna@example.com to Northwind Studio as an editor.

review.commerce_description: Finometr does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Custom categories inside the standard ones on Pro and higher: create, rename, archive and restore them, and move earlier rows with set_category (a dry run first, up to 200 rows a call). Transaction searches take up to 366 days; a longer period is clipped to its last 366 days with a note. Tool descriptions brought up to date with the server.
